identity.documentedCompilationTitle: 2 Games: Syphon Filter 2 / In Cold Blood
identity.reason: MobyGames documents the 2003 PlayStation twin pack as containing Syphon Filter 2 and In Cold Blood. The RegionAtlas/PriceCharting-style title omits the numeral 2 and appears to be a seed-title mismatch rather than a different documented pack.

confirmedFacts.claim: The compilation is a PlayStation twin pack containing Syphon Filter 2 and In Cold Blood.
MobyGames dates the documented German release to 2003-10-08 and credits Sony Computer Entertainment Europe Ltd.
MobyGames lists alternate titles 2 Giochi: Syphon Filter 2 / A Sangue Freddo and 2 Spiele: Syphon Filter 2 / Cold Blood.
The compilation supports 1-2 players; MobyGames lists same/split-screen and free-for-all/one-on-one VS as applicable specs across the included games.
Germany has a documented 2 Spiele / twinpack SKU with EAN 0711719662310 and USK 16.
German 2 Games/2 Spiele disc records include Cold Blood SCES-02151 and SCES-12151, and Syphon Filter 2 SCES-02287/T1 and SCES-12287/T2 variants.
Italy has a documented 2003 compilation 2 giochi: Syphon Filter 2 & A sangue freddo.
Italian Syphon Filter 2 uses SCES-02288/SCES-12288 and pal-ita explicitly notes a BIG BOX CON A SANGUE FREDDO - FULL ITA.
Italian A Sangue Freddo uses SCES-02152/SCES-12152 and has Italian menus/gameplay; Redump marks those discs as appearing in 2 Giochi.
MobyGames has distinct physical cover/media galleries for United Kingdom and The Netherlands for this compilation.
